title_zh: 我国在文昌成功发射卫星互联网低轨29组卫星
title_en: China Successfully Launches 29th Batch of Satellite Internet Low-Orbit Satellites from Wenchang
summary_zh: 11月9日4时24分，我国在海南商业航天发射场使用长征十二号运载火箭，成功将卫星互联网低轨29组卫星送入预定轨道，发射任务圆满成功。
summary_en: On Nov 9 at 04:24, China used a Long March 12 rocket at the Hainan Commercial Spaceport to launch the 29th batch of satellite internet low-orbit satellites, which entered their planned orbit successfully.
